verdict.rationale: Paxos is an API-first platform. It documents machine-to-machine OAuth 2 client-credentials authentication with scoped API credentials, which lets automation run without a UI. It also provides a Developer Sandbox that replicates the core v2 API with test funds for end-to-end integration testing, a natural fit for CI. However, there is no CLI, no CI-specific guidance or examples, and webhook configuration and testing are documented only through the Dashboard UI. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless tooling, documented CI/CD integration patterns, API-based (non-Dashboard) webhook setup, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Paxos APIs use OAuth 2 with the client credentials grant flow.
API credentials using Client ID and Secret. Set allowed scopes to access specific API endpoints.
The Developer Sandbox replicates core v2 API functionality with an automated system that uses test funds to simulate normal activities
Source test crypto assets from faucets and deposit them into your Sandbox account for end-to-end integration testing.
